status: PROPOSED v3: gray line owner-approved (v2, unchanged); cream line revised, awaiting owner review (2026-11-08)
meaning: Below the approved peet line there are three parts: the cream peet (image left), the underfluff tuft (middle) and the gray peet (image right). These two lines divide them, each from the peet line down to the body outline.
how: Top points on the approved peet line (owner: fine) and bottom corners on the body outline kept from v1. Between them each line follows its peet's own roundness: each peet's known outline (outer side and bottom along the body line, top along the peet line) was fitted with a rounded-box shape (superellipse; cream n=2.5, gray n=4.1, median fit error ~1-2 px) and its tuft-side curve used. Cream: own-outline fit for the upper/middle part, eased into the bottom corner (fit anchored at the corner bulged outside the body). Gray: fit anchored at both ends. Both stay inside the body outline, are smooth, and never cut in more than v1 (bulge vs v1: cream 17 px, gray 8 px). How far each peet reaches into the shadow by the tuft is not directly visible; this is the fitted curvature. v3 (cream only): the junction with the peet line moved from x 433 to x 450, above the widest point of the peet's side (x 453 at y 1183), so the peet's shoulder is no longer cut off; the shoulder rounds into the peet line; below the widest point the line is unchanged from v2. Adds up to 10.5 px of peet vs v2, cuts none.
